institutionHighlight.name: KL Deemed to be University (Koneru Lakshmaiah Education Foundation)
institutionHighlight.directorate: Department of Physical Education & Sports Sciences
institutionHighlight.description: KLU is a premier higher-education institution with an exceptional sports excellence program, offering sports scholarships, high-performance coaching, and national-standard grounds that have propelled dozens of student-athletes to South Zone Inter-University, All India Inter-University, Khelo India, and Senior National & State Kho-Kho teams.
